name: Kneeling Ab Wheel Rollout
cues: Kneel on a pad with the wheel under your shoulders
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze your glutes
Roll forward until your body nearly lines up from knees to hands
Keep your lower back from sagging as you pull the wheel home

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: At the start the arm is 24 deg forward of vertical (hands ~0.28 m ahead of the shoulders), which contradicts the cue 'wheel under your shoulders'. At full reach the thigh is 28 deg up and the trunk 7 deg, a ~20 deg hip break, so 'body nearly lines up knees to hands' is only loosely met. Gates are clean.
